# Extract of entities.json of the HTML Living Standard (the WHATWG list of named character
# references), taken on 2026-11-21 from https://html.spec.whatwg.org/entities.json.
#
# Selection: every entry whose code points are exactly one character of the typographic set of
# design section 11.2 (no-break space, narrow no-break space, thin space, non-breaking hyphen,
# en and em dash, ellipsis, quotes, minus, times, primes, legal marks, arrows, math signs) or one
# of the characters that HTML text escapes (& < > " '). The entries are unmodified: one source
# line each, without its trailing comma. No entry of the full list has the code point U+202F or
# U+2011, which is why they are written as numeric references.
#
# Used only by tests/output.rs (design sections 11.2, 13.1 and 13.2); excluded from the published
# package (`exclude` in Cargo.toml).
#
# Source and license: the WHATWG HTML Living Standard,
# Copyright (c) WHATWG (Apple, Google, Mozilla, Microsoft). This work is licensed under a
# Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License
# (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
# Attribution: "Data from the HTML Living Standard, https://html.spec.whatwg.org/, by WHATWG
# (Apple, Google, Mozilla, Microsoft), CC BY 4.0."
#
# Format: lines starting with `#` are comments; every other non-empty line is a source line
# `"&name;": { "codepoints": [N], "characters": "\uXXXX" }`.
